note: Pacta Conventa (1102) joined Croatia in personal union with Hungary; persisted through medieval period.

_quarry.structural_significance: The Pacta Conventa (1102) creating a personal union with Hungary while preserving Croatian autonomy established the template for composite kingship arrangements that defined central European constitutional development; Croatia's maintained Sabor assembly and ban office persisted as living evidence that medieval federalism could preserve constituent identity within larger political unions.
